data.name: Fatih
data.gender_notes: Fatih is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘fatha’ meaning ‘to open’ or ‘to conquer’. The name Fatih signifies a victorious, conquering personality. In Islamic history, Fatih refers to Sultan Mehmet II who conquered Constantinople in 1453, thus earning the title ‘Fatih the Conqueror’. The name Fatih carries the meaning “Victorious, Conqueror” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fatih usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious, conqueror and live with faith, good character and purpose.
